about: A Honduran-made Hoyo de Monterrey from General Cigar (Scandinavian Tobacco Group), rolled in Danli with a Honduran OSA wrapper over a broadleaf binder. It first appeared in September 2026 as the toro in the Hoyo New Legends Sampler.
